record.title: European Commission publishes an AI Act harmonized-standards decision for high-risk systems
record.summary: The European Commission’s official AI standards index lists Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2274, adopted on October 12 and published in the Official Journal on October 14, as concerning harmonized standards for high-risk AI systems under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689. This is a current step in the Act’s standards process. The linked legal text could not be retrieved in this review, so the specific standard references and detailed requirements remain unverified; no provider adoption or compliance outcome is established.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: The European Commission index lists Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2274, dated 12 October 2026 and published in the Official Journal on 14 October 2026, concerning harmonized standards for high-risk AI systems under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689.

claims.label: INFERRED
claims.text: Publication of the decision is a regulatory implementation step toward harmonized standards for high-risk AI systems; the specific standards, detailed requirements and provider uptake were not established in this review.

evidence_gaps.description: The linked EUR-Lex text could not be retrieved; exact listed standards, covered requirements and effective provisions were not inspected.
No evidence was gathered on whether providers have adopted the cited standards or how they affect compliance practice.

brief.importance_rationale: If this decision makes harmonized standards available for high-risk AI providers, it can affect how organizations operationalize AI Act obligations across the EU. The accessible evidence establishes publication of the decision, while its specific provisions and real-world uptake remain unverified.
limitations: Evidence is the Commission’s official index entry; linked legal text was blocked during this activation.
